thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Autoscaler failing to provision GPUs in asia-east2 — queue growth detected > 3000 pending requests. Autoscale logs show 'quotaExceeded' from cloud provider. Paging oncall.

alex: I'm on it. Seeing a steady queue growth on inference-prod-asia-east2. Autoscaler attempts to create nodes, API returns 403 / QuotaExceeded.

maria: Confirmed from infra view — GCP returned 403 with message 'Quota limit for GPUs reached for project'. No new GPUs can be provisioned right now.

jamal: How widespread is customer impact?

nina: Observed increased latency and 503s for the asia region. Top affected tenants: ridex, medicai (B2B). CS is getting tickets.

chris: FYI medicai reported a spike in error rates 2m ago. They're running nightly batch transforms — might be hitting us harder.

alex: Immediate mitigation ideas: 1) divert new requests from asia-east2 to fallback region ap-southeast1 where capacity is healthy; 2) scale down noncritical capacity in asia-east2 (internal test pools); 3) gracefully degrade to smaller model (gpt-medium) for best-effort traffic. Thoughts?

priya: Routing is doable for HTTP API -- we can enable region-fallback policy per-customer in the router config. Patch takes ~2-3m to roll. I'll start.

maria: We can temporarily drain the non-prod pools and free up ~8 GPUs in asia-east2, but that won't clear the whole queue. Also opening a quota request to GCP console now — their usual SLA is slow.

jamal: Please post steps for me to run the router change if priya hits issues.

priya: Steps (quick):
```
# add fallback policy for asia-east2 -> ap-southeast1
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://router.internal/v1/policies \
  -d '{"from":"asia-east2","to":"ap-southeast1","policy":"fallback","priority":10}'
# ctrl plane will push config to edge within ~90s
```

alex: I'm going to throttle new enrollments too — reduce concurrency per API key to reduce inflow.

nina: Noted. CS communicating temporary throttle + potential region fallback to affected customers (medicai, ridex). Will hold messaging: "experiencing degraded performance in APAC; failover in progress".

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4302. Severity: high. Runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/gpu-quota-exhaustion. Paging infra@oncall.

cloud-support: GCP support ticket opened. Case #GCP-64211. They indicate soft limit at account level for 'nvidia-tesla-a100' in asia-east2. Requested expedited review but ETA uncertain.

maria: Running low-level autoscaler logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:04:12Z scale-controller: request new node: type a100-1
2026-03-15T09:04:13Z gcp-api: quotaExceeded: quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project 12345
2026-03-15T09:04:13Z scale-controller: retry in 30s
```

jamal: Can we attempt node provisioning with a different GPU SKU (v100/rtx) as a temporary compatibility plan? Some models run slower but acceptable for non-latency critical traffic.

priya: Runtime supports v100 and rtx-series with a config flag. We'll need to create a node-pool with alternate SKU and ensure model kernels are compiled for that backend. That takes ~10-15m for pool creation + bake.

alex: Do it. Prioritize small batch job traffic offloading to new pool if successful.

maria: Starting node-pool creation with rtx-6000 (asia-east2):
```
gcloud compute instances create-with-container node-pool-rtx-temp \
  --zone=asia-east2-a --machine-type=n1-standard-16 --accelerator=type=rtx-6000,count=1 \
  --project=redwood-prod
```

nina: CS prepped customer messaging draft and will ping for approval.

chris: If we route tenant workloads to ap-southeast1 we should check cost impact and token latency. Already notified product that some customers may see 80-120ms higher RTT.

alex: For immediate relief I enabled fallback routing for public-api keys at 09:06Z. Monitor for reduced queue.

incident-bot: Router config applied. New policy rollout: fallback asia-east2 -> ap-southeast1.

priya: Observing queue dropping from 3200 -> 1800 after fallback. Good sign. Some requests still pinned because of pinned region in client SDKs.

jamal: For pinned SDKs we can issue a 302 response with instructions to retry to fallback region — will implement quick header for 5m.

maria: node-pool creation succeeded for rtx-6000 but kube node provisioner shows taints not yet cleared. Waiting for kubelet registration.

maria: kube nodes registered at 09:14Z. Starting runtime agent deployment to new nodes.

priya: Runtime agent started, model kube-scheduler placing best-effort workloads onto rtx nodes. We're seeing small capacity utilization now. Queue dipping further to ~600.

nina: CS: medicai reports partial recovery — some jobs processed but slower. They asked for ETA to full recovery. What's our estimate?

alex: Short answer: partial mitigation in 15-20m, full recovery depends on GCP quota increase. If fallback + alternate SKU covers demand we may avoid waiting on quota. Tell them we're prioritizing their traffic on fallback.

cloud-support: GCP replied to case — manual quota adjustment request submitted. No ETA but flagged for accelerated review.

jamal: Action items so far:
- Priya: router fallback applied (done)
- Maria: provisioned rtx node-pool and deployed runtime (done)
- Alex: throttled new enrollments and prioritized tenants (done)
- Nina/CS: customer comms in-flight (ongoing)
- Cloud-support: GCP ticket open (ongoing)

priya: One edge-case: some customers require GPU family A100 for correctness (fp16 kernels). For those we need to coordinate per-tenant model fallback. I'll follow up with SRE to create a temporary mapping.

nina: Chis: medicai says they require A100 for perf-critical pipelines, but are willing to run degraded model for now. They want an opt-in failover.

chris: I'll coordinate with medicai and get explicit opt-in.

alex: Preparing to handoff to second oncall at 09:22Z. Queue is at ~420 and trending down. Please take over monitoring, ensure GCP case is tracked and quota increases are reflected, and coordinate with product for tenant-level fallbacks.

jamal: Taking handoff. I'll remain primary until we close the incident. Handoff notes:
- Current mitigation: fallback routing to ap-southeast1 + rtx node-pool for best-effort
- Outstanding: GCP quota response, some pinned SDKs need header-based redirect, verify tenant-specific A100 needs
- Customer comms in flight

incident-bot: Handoff recorded. Next oncall: jamal. Handoff timestamp: 3379999308.

maria: Leaving a note — after quota increases arrive we should run a gentle burst test: create 3 a100 nodes and check allocation path. If quota remains constrained we should petition for project-level quota increases and consider splitting heavy tenants into a dedicated billing project.

jamal: A few follow-ups for postmortem:
- Why didn't autoscaler try alternate SKU earlier? config change to permit SKU fallback?
- Improve runbook to include quicker router fallback playbook and SDK redirect headers
- Add per-tenant fallback opt-in flag to Console

nina: CS will collate impacted tenant timelines and tickets.

chris: I'll reach out to medicai and ridex with a timeline and offer SRE liaison.

priya: Logging note: add a metric for 'quota-errors-per-region' so we can alert before queue reaches 2k.

alex: Thanks all. Monitoring continues under jamal. Will update when GCP confirms quota change. :thumbsup:
